summary: Independent re-verification (iter 68) of Slack Ask, Teams Ask, /slack/test, /ask-log, digest config secret masking, and SAP insight cache. Full backend pytest (15 tests) + Playwright e2e covering SoD Command Center Slack/Teams Ask setup blocks, Workflow Activity ask-log, and 14-route regression. All pass. Demo org reset (slack_ask=false, teams_ask=false) post-test.
verified_flows: Slack /api/sap/slack/ask PUBLIC: valid HMAC + response_url -> 200 ephemeral 'Analyzing...'; no response_url -> 200 in_channel grounded answer; empty text -> 200 ephemeral usage help with shortcut chips (`top risks` `score` `score trend` `critical` `residual`); shortcut 'top risks' -> grounded answer (not literal text); wrong secret -> 200 ephemeral 'isn't linked'; stale ts (>5 min) -> HTTP 401.
Teams /api/sap/teams/ask PUBLIC: valid base64 HMAC -> 200 {type:message, text: grounded}; '<at>Bot</at> critical' -> shortcut expanded, <at> stripped; wrong secret -> 200 message 'isn't linked'.
Admin /api/sap/slack/test -> 200 {ok, question, answer(grounded), signing_secret_set, webhook_configured, webhook_posted}; unauthenticated -> 401/403.

/api/sap/ask-log -> 200 {entries[{source,user_name,question,answer,at}], total, by_source:{slack,teams,test}}; entries accumulate after slack/teams/test calls (observed 11 entries in workflow UI, by_source populated).

/api/sap/digest/config GET always masks slack_signing_secret & teams_ask_secret to '' with slack_signing_secret_set/teams_ask_secret_set booleans; PUT with blank secret preserves the previously stored one (verified: subsequent HMAC-signed slack request still validated).
/api/sap/insight?focus=SoD: 1st call ~few seconds (LLM), immediate 2nd identical call <1s (0.15s in test) with byte-identical JSON (180s cache confirmed).

FRONTEND /app/sod: slack-ask-toggle ON reveals slack-ask-setup with url ending /api/sap/slack/ask, copy, secret input, shortcuts chips, test button. slack-ask-test click surfaces slack-ask-test-result with a grounded answer ('The top risks are the 71 open SoD conflicts...'). teams-ask-toggle ON reveals teams-ask-setup with url ending /api/sap/teams/ask + copy + secret. digest-save PUT 200, and after reload both toggles remain aria-checked=true (persistence confirmed).
FRONTEND /app/workflow: ask-log-card and ask-log-list render with 11 entries after our test invocations.

REGRESSION 14 routes (/app, /app/sod, /app/identities, /app/privileged, /app/monitoring, /app/lifecycle, /app/analytics, /app/workflow, /app/requests, /app/certifications, /app/roles, /app/activation, /app/reconciliation, /app/systems): every route rendered a [data-testid^=sap-insight-] AI Analyst card, zero pageerrors captured, no 'X is not defined' runtime errors.
critical_code_review_comments: SodCommandCenter.jsx continues to grow; still worth splitting Slack/Teams Ask blocks into a dedicated ChannelAskConfig subcomponent (non-blocking, previously flagged).
Consider adding rate-limit / abuse guard on public /api/sap/slack/ask and /api/sap/teams/ask beyond HMAC and 5-minute freshness (e.g., per-org QPS).
seed_data_creation: Temporarily set slack_signing_secret / teams_ask_secret to known HMAC-testable values on demo org; ask-log gained ~5 new entries from test invocations. Post-test: RESET performed — slack_ask=false, teams_ask=false, both secrets cleared, digest-save confirmed via toast 'Governance digest schedule saved'. Demo org pristine.
context_for_next_testing_agent: All ask-channel features live and verified. Backend regression file /app/backend/tests/test_iter68_ask_channels.py is idempotent (enables secrets in fixture, resets in teardown) and safe to re-run. SAP insight cache is confirmed 180s; if you need a fresh LLM call, change focus param.
